scope: About 50 additional Entertainment prompts; original prompt collection only.
rights: Prompt bodies are unchanged source text. The 42 VibeFather prompts are CC BY-NC 4.0 and require attribution and non-commercial use; commercial use/client work requires separate permission. MIT notices and the Superdesign repository CC0 prompt dedication are retained. Referenced media, fonts, game brands, demo source and screenshots keep separate rights and were not downloaded.
limitations: Some inputs specify full games, multiple pages, server-backed streaming, third-party services or placeholder parameters; collection does not implement, validate or publish these experiences. Two original prompts are Chinese or mixed-language; future site generation must reconcile them with the gallery English-language requirement. Two CC0 specifications describe standalone music-player UI rather than marketing homepages. Tarot and personality quizzes are entertainment concepts, not validated professional or clinical advice.

category_review.rationale: Playable virtual garden for planting flowers, changing the wind and sharing a garden postcard.

The four names map in order to radial, cup, bell, and star procedural flower geometries. This is a playable full-viewport toy, not a marketing landing page.
